A [[Pineath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] nicknamed "'''Feathers spokesman'''", along with three other Pineath, attempted to trick several [[Troukree]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], including agent [[Vaantaar]], into paying him double for the supposedly broken [[Troukree knife]] the refugees had provided him<ref name="Choices of One" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> In truth, the Troukree refugees had [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] a knife in perfect condition, which the Pineath refused to accept. After [[Daric LaRone]], a member of the [[Hand of Judgment]], learnt the Feathers spokeman's and Vaantar's reasoning, he asked to see the broken knife. Although the spokesman hesitated to show it, he gave in, revealing his treachery. The Pineath then departed while thanking Larone for not dishonoring him by announcing his treachery to the crowd surrounding them.<ref name="Choices of One" />
